generationPolicy.phase1: local crop extraction only; no external image or 3D generation
generationPolicy.phase2: generate clean white-background multiview images per unique module after user confirms external-cost generation
generationPolicy.phase3: generate textured GLB per module, normalize while preserving materials, then compose final scene layout
